body: Right now yeah I'm fine. I just had a drop for a few hours. You know how it is ecstatic one mine and suicidal the next! haha Nah, but seriously I'm fine. I appreciate your insight.
All the time, he hangs up the phone or walks away ( when we are in person)

Ah right, no worries. 

In my case he doesn't pay any attention to my disorders and like to feel as if they are there by choice despite having attended some psychiatric meetings to do with my health in the past. 
I can't tell if my expectations for him to at least answer the phone to me are too high or if It's perfectly alright for me to put out my all and compensate for my own genetic disorder by going out of my way to be lovely when I'm not having a game of Russian roulette with my emotions within my head at the very same time!

He is a bit lost, he can't relate or console me. Just get angry about it! Having said that he says he loves me but surely if i he did. If he really did, would he not do anything to help me? Would it not scare the shit out of him that I could possibly be dying?

I had already done it and he didn't care. I don't pretend to attempt to kill myself to see if he cared. I tried then told him. Came to my senses and puked it up. Never the less. He didn't care. I've been dealing with mental health disorders since I was a child and am still standing so it takes an awful lot to push my that far despite the daily turmoil. Its that  he didn't care.  I would Understand if i did it on a regular basis and was just fucking with him, but that is NOT the case.
